# Odra smart-contract framework

> Documentation for Odra, the Rust framework for writing, testing and deploying Casper smart contracts, indexed from its source (odradev/odradev.github.io): odra.dev's own llms.txt links only HTML pages.

Each link fetches the page's raw markdown; the URL after the colon is where it is published.
Generated by https://github.com/msanlisavas/casper-llms from odradev/odradev.github.io@219169e.
